dataset: Synthetic Banking Transaction Dataset with Multi-Pattern Fraud Labels for Machine Learning Research

dataset_provenance.version: Mendeley Data version 2; training script input named Fraud Detection Dataset.csv

files.name: Fraud Detection Dataset.csv
files.not_available_reason: The one-million-row training CSV was not committed; provenance is recorded by the training script.

dataset_provenance.split_reference: Script slices the customer/time-sorted feature frame 70% train, 15% validation and 15% test; only normal training windows fit the autoencoder.

output.threshold_basis: 99th percentile of normal validation reconstruction errors; tune to the bank's review capacity.

handoff_note: The .keras metadata records Keras 3.13.2 and input shape (10, 33). TensorFlow runtime is pinned for serving compatibility; the training TensorFlow version was not exported.
